title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap and private-installer integration
author: Evelyn Park
description:
This PR adds automation for tenant RBAC bootstrap used by the Private installer (VPC/on-prem) and integrates the role manifests into the rbac-policy-bundle Helm and Terraform outputs. Motivation: onboarding private tenants currently requires manual role creation and ad-hoc kubeconfig edits. This change provides a reproducible, auditable flow for tenant bootstrap with minimum operator privileges, tenant isolation role templates, and clear audit-log-friendly subjects.

What this PR does:
- Adds templated ClusterRole and RoleBinding manifests for tenant bootstrap with parameterized tenant_id, environment, and KMS key ARN. These live under policies/tenant-bootstrap/*.yaml and are Helm-templated for use by private-installer.
- Exposes a new helm subchart (rbac-tenant-bootstrap) and values to enable automatic application during private-installer helm installs.
- Updates the private-installer chart values to accept `bootstrapServiceAccount` and `bootstrapToken` parameters and documents required KMS/HSM IAM bindings.
- Adds a Terraform module wrapper (terraform/modules/tenant_rbac) that outputs the RBAC YAML as rendered templates and a CLI helper (scripts/tenant-bootstrap.sh) to apply the generated manifests via the operator's service account.
- Adds e2e integration tests (perf-canary style smoke) that validate tenant isolation (namespace-scoped access), KV cache access restrictions, and audit log entries for bootstrap actions.
- Adds an automated cleanup job to remove bootstrap rolebindings after tenant onboarding confirmed.

Checklist:
- [x] Role and RoleBinding templates added
- [x] Helm subchart and values documented
- [x] Terraform module + examples included
- [x] Installer integration and docs updated (private-installer/README.md)
- [x] Tests and CI pipeline steps added
- [x] Security review performed (Priya)

Notes on privileges and safety:
- Bootstrap roles are intentionally minimal: they allow creation of the tenant namespace, service account creation within that namespace, and permission to request a limited, short-lived K8s token. They do NOT grant cluster-admin or node privileges.
- The installer must be run from a bastion or CI environment that has KMS/HSM encryption permissions; terraform module documents required IAM roles.

Related: ENG-6421 (Private tenant onboarding), ENG-6590 (installer automation), SUP-1043 (customer support request for automated tenant provisioning).

files_changed: policies/tenant-bootstrap/01-tenant-namespace.yaml - template for tenant namespace creation (Helm values: tenantId, env)
policies/tenant-bootstrap/02-bootstrap-role.yaml - minimal privileges for bootstrap SA (create namespace, create serviceaccounts, create rolebindings)
charts/rbac-tenant-bootstrap/Chart.yaml - new subchart wiring templates into private-installer
charts/private-installer/values.yaml - added bootstrapServiceAccount/bootstrapToken and rbac-tenant-bootstrap.enabled flags
terraform/modules/tenant_rbac/main.tf - module that renders Helm templates and stores rendered YAML in outputs
scripts/tenant-bootstrap.sh - CLI helper to render/apply templates and wait for onboarding completion
tests/e2e/tenant_bootstrap_smoke.go - integration smoke test for tenant isolation and audit logs
docs/private-installer/README.md - documented bootstrap flow, IAM/KMS requirements, rollback notes
discussion: Marco Alvarez (reviewer): Nice work — critical automation. A few asks: ensure the bootstrap role cannot escalate into clusterroles (defense in depth), add a TTL for the bootstrap service account, and document the attacker surface in the README.
Evelyn Park (author): Thanks Marco — added TTL annotation and explicit deny rules for clusterrolebinding escalation. Updated README with attacker surface and recommended bastion usage.

Priya Desai (security): Verified the minimal privilege surface. One nit: the KMS ARN binding in terraform should be least-privilege (encrypt/decrypt only) — please split the policy into two IAM statements. Also add an audit log test asserting the bootstrap principal is recorded.

Evelyn Park (author): Split KMS policy into two statements, added audit log assertion to e2e smoke test. CI initially failed on linter (YAML ordering) and e2e timing flakiness; fixed ordering and added exponential backoff + retry in tests.

Luke Chen (reviews): CI passed on my last run. Small suggestion: namespace naming in the templates should include a short hash to avoid collisions in parallel CI runs. I updated the template and test to include {{ .Values.tenantId | regexReplaceAll "[^a-z0-9-]" "-" | truncate 12 }}-{{ randAlphaNum 6 }} pattern.
Priya Desai (approver): Security approval granted. Please ensure there is a rollback path documented for failed onboarding — keeping RBAC cleanup as a failsafe.
release_notes: Automated tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer: adds Helm subchart, Terraform module, CLI helper and e2e checks to enable repeatable tenant onboarding while preserving tenant isolation.
